authority_statement: Rules and gate limits only — no frozen result values. This file defines the floor-free five-index canonical line (SPX, CCMP, NDX, SOX, KOSPI): one single stable-growth terminal, direct per-index operands only, and fail-closed row statuses. It contains no published floor/headline evidence, no per-index target value, no order coefficient, and no alternate terminal family. Changing a rule or a gate limit requires an explicit criteria revision; changing a result never does because no result lives here.

units.fair_value_upside: fraction of spot (fair_value / spot - 1); percentage points = fraction * 100

public_surface.rule: the five-index canonical line is quarantined from public promotion until a separate owner approval; rows never set display_ready

order.role: boolean diagnostic only. The builder never reorders rows, never shifts values, never floors values and never throws because the desired order differs. The diagnostic reports non-increasing adjacent pairs and non-finite rows.
order.min_adjacent_gap_pp_note: gaps are reported inside violations; no gap threshold is enforced

notation.B0: index-level book value per index point at the price as-of (inputs.json indices.<IDX>.derived.book_value)
notation.eps[t]: FY1..FY3 consensus index earnings per index point (inputs.json indices.<IDX>.derived.forecast_grid_v1.periods[].earnings_proxy)
notation.ke: cost of equity for the cell = per-index observed Rf + per-index observed ERP
notation.LTROE: trailing-10y median of the index benchmark ROE series (see ltroe)

equations.book_roll_forward: B[t] = B[t-1] + eps[t] * retention, for t = 1..3, starting from B0
equations.explicit_residual_income: RI[t] = eps[t] - ke * B[t-1], for t = 1..3

base_cell_rule: BASE is the base-ERP x base-LTROE cell of the 3x3 grid: ke = Rf + ERP_base and ltroe = LTROE_base. fair_value = BASE; fair_value_upside = BASE / spot - 1, same-as-of with the price.

stable_growth.g_macro_policy: fixed documented policy parameter, not a market input and not a result: g_macro = (1 + real_GDP_longer_run) * (1 + PCE_inflation_longer_run) - 1 with the FOMC Summary of Economic Projections longer-run medians (June 2026 SEP Table 1: real GDP 2.0%, PCE inflation 2.0%). Changing it requires an explicit criteria revision. There is no fallback: a missing or non-finite g_macro_value emits a NULL row with an explicit blocker; it is never silently defaulted.

ltroe.rule: median of the index benchmark ROE series over the trailing 10 calendar years ending at the latest benchmark row date at or before the price as-of, after dropping non-finite values. Never hardcoded per index; never taken from a frozen result.

grid.rule: 3x3 cells: ERP low/base/high = per-index observed ERP -/+ half width; LTROE low/base/high = derived LTROE -/+ half width (low floored at 0)

source_clocks.rule: point-in-time: every required operand's availability date must be <= the row valuation price as-of. A later operand emits NULL with a freshness/PIT blocker. Availability dates are the declared as_of/coverage dates carried by each operand in inputs.json.
source_clocks.date_key_whitelist: only the explicit economic observation/availability keys in economic_date_key_allowlist count as an operand clock, and their values must be exact valid YYYY-MM-DD dates. Processing timestamps (generated_at_date, *_generated_at, *_collected_at, *_fetched_at, *_created_at) are never treated as an economic observation date.

per_operand.book_value: price row date (derived from observed.price + observed.price_to_book, both benchmark-row fields)
per_operand.payout_ratio: latest declared date inside derived.payout_ratio (coverage.*_date / coverage.*_as_of)
per_operand.forecast_grid_v1: latest declared date inside the grid, else max(payout availability, observed.forward_eps.as_of) because the grid embeds payout and forward-EPS growth

freshness.rule: the price freshness block must carry the required status and stay inside the max calendar age; every source-clock rule above must hold. Violations emit NULL with a freshness blocker.

directness.rule: required operands must be direct exact-index inputs. Blocked, house-assumption, proxy-marked or methodology-derived inputs emit NULL with a direct-input blocker, except for the single SOX methodology reconstruction contract below when every gate passes.

sox_methodology_exception.scope: SOX only; methodology_derived_index_weight_source remains prohibited everywhere else
sox_methodology_exception.rule: Admit a dynamically reproducible SOX reconstruction only when official Nasdaq GIW membership for index_id SOX is combined with stock_action market caps and the published Nasdaq SOX modified-market-cap methodology. Official weight columns remain unavailable and must be disclosed as false. Any missing, stale, proxy/ETF-mixed, incomplete, promoted, or structurally different evidence emits NULL.
sox_methodology_exception.required_source_field: rows[].symbol + computed/stock_action_index.marketCap -> SOX methodology capped weights

directness.sox_methodology_note: The exception validates official Nasdaq GIW SOX membership plus a transparent 12/10/8/4 iterative-cap reconstruction. It does not claim official weight columns and does not authorize SOXX/SOXQ, non-SOX methodology grids, output fitting, or public fair-value promotion.

sox_identity.price_source_rule: the SOX headline price must come from an exact direct Philadelphia Semiconductor Index source: the philadelphia_semi benchmark section (source_field), or a direct ^SOX daily index observation (source/source_field naming the ^SOX index symbol). SOXX or any other ETF/proxy identity emits NULL with an identity blocker.

payout_policy.ccmp: forecast_grid_v1 and a non-null payout are required; until inputs.json provides them, CCMP emits a NULL row with direct-input blockers
payout_policy.kospi: payout_ratio == 0 or unverified emits NULL, never value-plus-warning

G1_pole_margin.rule: ke - g >= limit in every cell

G2_terminal_share.rule: terminal share of V0 at the base cell <= limit

G5_monotonicity.rule: value non-increasing in ERP at fixed LTROE, non-decreasing in LTROE at fixed ERP, and BULL >= BASE >= BEAR

prohibitions: no published floor/headline evidence of any kind is read
no per-index target value or order coefficient
SOXX must never define the SOX headline
no alternate terminal family and no dependency on any other terminal authority
no silent NULL: a blocked row must state its blockers
